senses.gloss:
mfn. (-जुः-जुः-जु)
Wicked, perverse, crooked, not straight, physically or morally.
E.
अन् neg. and ऋजु straight.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Free from debt.
E.
अन् neg. ऋण debt.

mfn. (-णी-णिनी-णि)
Unindebted, free from debt.
E.
अन् neg. ऋणिन्^1 a debtor.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161130. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 301.

n. (-तं)
1 Falsehood.
2 Agriculture.
E.
अन् neg. and ऋत truth.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Speaking falsely, lying, a liar.
E.
अनृत, and वादिन् who speaks.

n. (-ण्यं)
Acquittance of debt or obligation.
E.
अनृणी out of debt, ण्यत् aff.

n. (-स्यं)
1 Mildness.
2 Cruelty.
E.
अनृशंस mild, and यञ् affix, or आङ् intensitive, and नृशंस्य cruelty.
